title: Modal Verbs (could, should, may, must)
summary: إزاي تستخدم can / could / should / may / must علشان تقدّم الحقائق بحذر وتقيّم الأدلة وتدّي نصايح وتوصيات.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: **Modal verbs** (can, could, should, ought to, may, might, must) are special helping verbs. We use them to **present facts carefully**, to **evaluate evidence** and to **make recommendations**.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن أفعال صغيرة بتيجي **قبل الفعل الأساسي** وبتغيّر «طعم» الجملة: هل الحاجة **ممكنة**؟ ولا **لازم**؟ ولا أنا **بنصحك** بيها؟ ولا أنا **مش متأكد**؟

في الكتاب الدرس ده في **Unit 5: The Greenhouse Effect**، جزء **Grammar Focus: Modal verbs to present facts carefully and evaluate evidence** (صفحة 154-155)، ومرتبط بالـ podcast عن الطاقة المتجددة، وبعدها بتستخدمها في كتابة الـ **Informational Leaflet**. الكتاب بيقول: استخدم الـ modals علشان **متكتبش كل حاجة كأنها حقيقة مطلقة** (Avoid stating everything as absolute fact).
الفكرة ببساطة: «درجة التأكيد»

text: Modals show **how sure** we are, or **how strong** our advice is. Compare: *Solar energy* **solves** *the problem* (100% fact) and *Solar energy* **may solve** *the problem* (possible, not certain).

blocks.text: تخيّل إن عندك «عدّاد ثقة». لما تقول «الطاقة الشمسية **هتحل** المشكلة» إنت متأكد 100%. لكن العلماء والكتّاب المحترمين بيقولوا «الطاقة الشمسية **ممكن تحل** المشكلة» لأن المستقبل مش مؤكد. ده اسمه **hedging** (يعني: إنك تخفف كلامك وتتكلم بحذر علشان تبقى دقيق).

items.en: Battery storage **solves** the problem of intermittency.
items.ar: كأنها حقيقة مؤكدة 100%. ده كلام قوي زيادة لو لسه فيه بحث.

items.en: Battery storage **may solve** the problem of intermittency.
items.ar: ممكن تحلها، بس مش أكيد. ده كلام **حذر ودقيق** (hedge). intermittency = إن الطاقة مش بتيجي طول الوقت، زي الشمس بالليل.

blocks.text: القواعد الذهبية للـ Modals

text: Modals **never change their form**: no -s, no -ed, no -ing. After a modal we use the **base verb** (infinitive without *to*). To make the negative add **not**. To make a question move the modal **before the subject**.

rows: بعد الـ modal الفعل **مصدر** من غير to
الـ modal **مبياخدش s** مع he / she / it
**ought to** هي الوحيدة اللي فيها to

blocks.text: كل Modal ومعناه (جدول الكتاب + شرح زيادة)

text: The book groups modals by function: **possibility or potential**, **recommendations**, **uncertainty**, and **strong necessity**.

rows: Wind farms **can** generate electricity for entire regions.
إمكانية في المستقبل (potential)، أو قدرة في الماضي
Solar energy **could** power entire cities by 2050.
ضرورة قوية أو حاجة مستعجلة (necessity / urgency)
Governments **must** invest in clean energy now.

blocks.text: رتّبهم كده من الأضعف للأقوى في **الاحتمال**: might ← may / could ← can ← (فعل عادي = حقيقة). وفي **الإلزام**: should / ought to (نصيحة) ← must (لازم).
أمثلة من موضوعات الوحدة

items.en: Egypt **can** produce huge amounts of solar power because it is sunny most of the year.
items.ar: مصر **تقدر** تنتج طاقة شمسية كتير. can = قدرة مؤكدة.

items.en: Electric buses **could** reduce air pollution in Cairo.
items.ar: الأتوبيسات الكهربا **ممكن** تقلل تلوث الهوا في القاهرة. إمكانية في المستقبل.

items.en: Experts believe electric cars **may** become the global standard within a decade.
items.ar: الخبراء شايفين إن العربيات الكهربا **يمكن** تبقى هي الأساس. مش أكيد.

items.en: Rising seas **might** affect some villages in the Delta.
items.ar: ارتفاع البحر **ممكن** يأثر على قرى في الدلتا. احتمال أضعف.

items.en: Schools **should** consider installing solar panels on their roofs.
items.ar: المدارس **المفروض** تفكر تركّب ألواح شمسية. نصيحة.

items.en: Young people **ought to** turn off lights when they leave a room.
items.ar: الشباب **ينبغي** يطفوا النور. نفس معنى should.

items.en: We **must** act now to protect future generations.
Factories **must not** dump waste into the Nile.
items.ar: **ممنوع** المصانع ترمي مخلفات في النيل. must not = ممنوع.

items.en: Solar panels **cannot** produce electricity at night, so we need batteries to store energy.
items.ar: الألواح الشمسية **مش بتقدر** تنتج كهربا بالليل، علشان كده محتاجين بطاريات تخزّن الطاقة.
سؤال: هل **المفروض** الحكومات تمنع الأكياس البلاستيك؟ should قبل الفاعل.

blocks.text: فروق مهمة لازم تعرفها

text: Some pairs look similar but mean different things: **must not** vs **do not have to**, **can** vs **could**, **may** vs **must** (for deduction).

rows: You **mustn't** burn rubbish in the street.
You **don't have to** buy new solar panels. You can rent them.
The air is grey. There **must** be a lot of pollution.
That **can't** be true. Solar power is getting cheaper, not more expensive.

blocks.text: ولو عايز تتكلم عن **الماضي** بنفس الأفكار، بنستخدم **modal + have + التصريف التالت**:

items.en: We **should have planted** more trees years ago.
items.ar: كان **المفروض** نزرع شجر أكتر من سنين (ومعملناش). ندم على الماضي.

items.en: The ice **may have melted** because of the heat wave.
items.ar: الجليد **يمكن يكون** داب بسبب موجة الحر. احتمال عن الماضي.

blocks.text: إزاي تستخدمها في الـ Leaflet والـ Argument

text: In a leaflet, use **should / can** for friendly advice and **must** for urgent calls to action. In an argument, use **may / could** to hedge claims and evaluate evidence carefully.

blocks.text: الكتاب عايزك تستخدم الـ modals في حاجتين:

items: **الـ Leaflet**: نصيحة ودودة (**You should…** / **You can start small…**) وفي الـ call to action ممكن **must** للتأكيد.
**تقييم الأدلة والـ JRE**: بدل ما تقول «solar is the best» قول «solar **may be** the most important source at the moment» علشان تبقى دقيق ومتوازن.

text: **The sun shines on Egypt almost every day. Why not use it?** Solar panels **can** turn sunlight into electricity for your home. Extra energy **may** even be sold back to the grid. You **should** talk to your parents or your school about rooftop panels. If you are not ready for that, you **could** start small with a solar charger. The climate crisis is your generation's challenge, so we **must** act today!

blocks.text: لاحظ: can = قدرة مؤكدة، may = احتمال، should = نصيحة، could = اقتراح خيار، must = حاجة مستعجلة.

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء (غلط ← صح)
items: ✗ Solar energy could **to power** cities. ← ✓ Solar energy could **power** cities.
✗ The government **musts** act. ← ✓ The government **must** act.
✗ Wind farms can **generates** electricity. ← ✓ Wind farms can **generate** electricity.
✗ We **don't should** waste water. ← ✓ We **shouldn't** waste water.
✗ **Do** we can stop climate change? ← ✓ **Can** we stop climate change?
✗ You mustn't buy new panels (وإنت قصدك «مش لازم»). ← ✓ You **don't have to** buy new panels.
✗ Schools ought install panels. ← ✓ Schools ought **to** install panels.

blocks.title: إزاي تجاوب بسرعة في الامتحان
items: الكتاب بيحط المعنى بين قوسين: **(ability)** = can، **(possibility)** = may / could / might، **(advice/recommendation)** = should، **(necessity)** = must.
لو الجملة فيها «**although this is not certain**» أو «**but more research is needed**» يبقى احتمال: **may / might / could**.
بعد أي modal: **فعل مصدر**. شوف الاختيار اللي فيه s أو ing أو to وشيله.

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات بتيجي بالأشكال دي:
**1) Complete with the correct modal verb.** (زي تمرين الكتاب، والمعنى بين قوسين)

text: Planting trees in cities ______ (possibility) lower summer temperatures, although results differ from place to place.

blocks.text: **الإجابة: may / could.** ليه؟ المعنى **احتمال**، وكمان الجملة قالت «although results differ» يعني مش أكيد.
**2) Only one sentence in each group is grammatically correct. Choose the correct answer.**

text: a. Governments must investing in clean energy.
b. Governments must to invest in clean energy.
c. Governments must invest in clean energy.
d. Governments musts invest in clean energy.

blocks.text: **الإجابة: c.** بعد must مصدر من غير to ومن غير ing، وmust مبتاخدش s.
**3) Rewrite the sentence more carefully using a modal verb.** (hedging)

text: Solar energy is the answer to all of Egypt's energy problems.

blocks.text: **الإجابة:** Solar energy **could / may be** an important answer to many of Egypt's energy problems. ليه؟ الجملة الأصلية مبالغة (كل المشاكل). الـ modal خلاها **حذرة ودقيقة** زي ما الكتاب بيطلب.
تدريب
**A. Complete with the correct modal verb (the meaning is given in brackets).**

items.q: 1. Solar panels ______ (ability) produce electricity even on cloudy days, but less of it.
2. Every school ______ (advice) have a recycling bin in each classroom.
3. Rising temperatures ______ (possibility) cause more water shortages in the future, although scientists are still studying this.
items.a: **may / might / could** — احتمال ومش مؤكد (still studying).

items.q: 4. The world ______ (strong necessity) cut carbon emissions now to avoid disaster.
5. Visitors ______ (prohibition) throw plastic into the sea.
6. You ______ (no necessity) buy an electric car to help the planet. Walking and cycling help too.

blocks.text: **B. Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

items.q:
7. Wind turbines ______ enough electricity for thousands of homes.
a. can generates  b. can generate  c. can to generate  d. can generating

8. Experts say electric cars ______ become common in Egypt within ten years, but this is not certain.
a. must  b. may  c. mustn't  d. have to

9. ______ we use solar energy at night?
a. Do we can  b. Can  c. Are  d. Does

10. People ______ waste water, especially in hot summers.
a. shouldn't  b. don't should  c. not should  d. shouldn't to

11. Look at the black smoke from that factory. It ______ be very harmful to people nearby.
a. must  b. mustn't  c. ought  d. don't have to
items.a: **a. must** — استنتاج من دليل (black smoke) = أكيد.

items.q:
12. Ten years ago, we ______ started recycling, but we didn't.
a. should  b. should have  c. must  d. can
items.a: **b. should have** — ندم على الماضي: should have + started.

blocks.text: **C. Only one sentence in each group is grammatically correct. Choose the correct answer.**

items.q:
13. a. The government musts protect the coast.
b. The government must protects the coast.
c. The government must protect the coast.
d. The government must to protect the coast.

14. a. Schools ought install solar panels.
b. Schools ought to install solar panels.
c. Schools ought to installing solar panels.
d. Schools oughts to install solar panels.

15. a. Battery storage may solves the problem.
b. Battery storage may solve the problem.
c. Battery storage mays solve the problem.
d. Battery storage may to solve the problem.

16. a. Do households should switch to solar?
b. Should households switch to solar?
c. Should households to switch to solar?
d. Households should switch to solar?
items.a: **b** — سؤال: Should + فاعل + مصدر. (d) جملة خبرية مش سؤال صح.

blocks.text: **D. Rewrite, correct or write as asked.**

items.q: 17. Rewrite more carefully (hedge): Plastic bans will end ocean pollution.
items.a: **Plastic bans could / may reduce ocean pollution.** — بدّلنا will بـ could/may، وend بـ reduce علشان منبالغش.

items.q: 18. Rewrite using should: It is a good idea for families to unplug devices at night.
items.a: **Families should unplug devices at night.** — a good idea = نصيحة = should.

items.q: 19. Rewrite using must: It is necessary for factories to reduce their emissions.
items.a: **Factories must reduce their emissions.** — necessary = must.

items.q: 20. Find and correct the mistake: Young people can to make a real difference.
items.a: شيل **to**: Young people **can make** a real difference.

items.q: 21. Find and correct the mistake: You mustn't recycle at home, but it is very helpful.
items.a: mustn't ← **don't have to**: You **don't have to** recycle at home, but it is very helpful. — المعنى «مش لازم» مش «ممنوع».

items.q: 22. Write a call to action for a leaflet about saving electricity. Use TWO modal verbs.
items.a: مثال: **You can** save energy by switching off lights. **You should** start today and tell your friends! — can = قدرة، should = نصيحة.

items.q: 23. JRE: Is solar energy the most useful renewable source for Egypt today? Use at least TWO modals.
items.a: مثال: **Justify:** Solar energy **may** be the most important renewable source at the moment. **Reason:** It is the fastest growing, and its cost has fallen sharply. **Evidence:** In Egypt, the Benban Solar Park already supplies electricity to many homes. However, without batteries it **cannot** supply power at night, so we **should** also invest in wind energy. — may = حذر، cannot = حدود، should = توصية.

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: **can** قدرة — **could / may / might** احتمال (حذر) — **should / ought to** نصيحة — **must** ضرورة قوية — **must not** ممنوع — **don't have to** مش لازم.
بعد أي modal **فعل مصدر من غير to** (ما عدا ought **to**)، ومفيش **s / ed / ing** على الـ modal.
في الكتابة استخدمها علشان **متقولش كل حاجة كأنها حقيقة مطلقة** (hedging)، وللنصيحة في الـ leaflet.
